character: A slim fox-featured man with a young sharp face of about thirty-five, silver-black fur dark through the coat with a cold silver wash at the temples and along the tails. Five tails held close together behind him. One fox ear stands upright and the other lies flat under his dark hair. Sharp amber eyes. A narrow closed smile with slightly too many teeth
wardrobe: an immaculate high-collared dark coat cut close for movement rather than display, a cravat in vivid signal-flag red, a heavy ring on one thumb, a small ship-shaped brooch at the lapel, excellent well-worn boots

full.framing: Full body standing portrait, front view, standing at ease with his hands clasped behind his back, plain neutral background.

portrait.framing: Head and shoulders portrait, square crop, filling the frame, facing the viewer, the narrow smile held.

scene.framing: A well dressed man leaning on a wooden rail above a sunken fighting pit, forearms crossed on the rail, looking down into the ring, a torchlit crowd behind him in shadow, sand and rope below.
